subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this stay an evidence-gathering gateway/package diagnosis, or should OpenClaw consider a new loopback/NAS auth-bypass or config-management behavior for this packaged deployment?
rationale: The source shows secure current behavior, but the requested work touches device pairing and auth bypasses while the Trim OS package owner and failing frame are unproven.

options.title: Keep auth boundary and request proof
options.body: Ask for a sanitized connect frame, gateway phase/auth logs, exact client and gateway package versions, and evidence of which Trim OS component rewrites config before changing code.

options.title: Open a diagnostics/docs follow-up
options.body: If maintainers decide the code is correct but hard to debug, track clearer gateway protocol logging and docs for `openclaw devices approve` and protocol mismatch recovery.

options.title: Design a new trusted loopback mode
options.body: If maintainers want a NAS-specific or loopback-only bypass, require a security-reviewed product design, default-off behavior, upgrade notes, and tests before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep auth boundary and request proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a sanitized connect frame, gateway phase/auth logs, exact client and gateway package versions, and evidence of which Trim OS component rewrites config before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged protocol-mismatch recovery work and gateway-client/device approval history make this the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
